latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: resolve 6 critical Dependabot alerts by @narcisonunez in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5351
* fix(ui): standardize settings layout widths to full width by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5406
* fix(auth): prefetch SSO state in SSR to prevent layout flash by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5407
* feat: transfer services between servers by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5396
* feat(compose): pull latest images on deploy toggle by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5410
* fix(compose): move Fresh Volumes into a Danger Zone with typed confirmation by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5411
* fix(vault): read Infisical secrets pulled in through an import by @aspatari in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5414
* chore(ci): update GitHub Actions to latest versions and harden workflows by @maks-oleksyuk in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5364
* feat: added missing Railpack versions by @KingIronMan2011 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5358
* fix(notifications): add missing newline to ntfy database backup message by @RezaRahemtola in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5350
* feat(compose): support models in Compose specification by @EgerDev in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5418
* fix(deps): bump next to 16.3.4 to patch critical RCE advisories by @narcisonunez in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5416
* fix(billing): pick a plan for the trial and warn before it expires by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5477
* fix(billing): allow switching billing interval during trial by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5515
* fix(cloud): load HubSpot chat widget for startup plan users by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5538
* fix: prevent add-invitation form from resetting on submission error by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5498
* fix: preserve application status when saving provider settings by @roshanasingh4 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5455
* feat(ui): enhance deployments layout and fix visual jumping by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5429
* fix(ui): unify tab header styles across backups, schedules, volume backups and patches by @y4aniv in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5535
* fix: accept deploy webhook payloads up to 25 MB by @Souvik-Cyclic in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5543
* fix: preserve compose status when saving provider settings by @roshanasingh4 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5544
* fix: count only physical disks in host Block I/O stats by @Souvik-Cyclic in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5540
* fix: redact S3 credentials in backup logs regardless of shell quoting by @Souvik-Cyclic in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5527
* fix: kill deployment log tail when the client disconnects early by @Souvik-Cyclic in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5529
* fix: mark session cookie as Secure when served over HTTPS by @Souvik-Cyclic in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5022
* feat(ai): add Perplexity integration attribution by @qirh in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5482
* feat: account deletion for Dokploy Cloud by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5463
* Revert "fix(ui): standardize settings layout widths to full width" by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5561
* fix(terminal): prevent terminal from collapsing on zoom by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5582
* fix(ui): resolve tooltips overlapping open modals on remote servers page by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5575
* fix(libsql): validate appName like the other database kinds by @cevheri in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5584
* feat(dns): add optional zone to OVH provider by @tomron in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5614
* feat

detail.readme_excerpt:
Join us on Discord for help, feedback, and discussions!


Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS) that simplifies the deployment and management of applications and databases. ## ✨ Features Dokploy includes multiple features to make your life easier. - **Applications**: Deploy any type of application (Node.js, PHP, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.). - **Databases**: Create and manage databases with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB, libsql, and Redis. - **Backups**: Automate backups for databases to an external storage destination. - **Docker Compose**: Native support for Docker Compose to manage complex applications. - **Multi Node**: Scale applications to multiple nodes using Docker Swarm to manage the cluster. - **Templates**: Deploy open-source templates (Plausible, Pocketbase, Calcom, etc.) with a single click. - **Traefik Integration**: Automatically integrates with Traefik for routing and load balancing. - **Real-time Monitoring**: Monitor CPU, memory, storage, and network usage for every resource. - **Logs & Metrics**: Ship container logs and host/container metrics to Grafana (Loki, Prometheus/Mimir), Datadog, New Relic, InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics, Better Stack, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch, tagged by project/environment/application. - **Docker Management**: Easily deploy and manage Docker containers. - **CLI/API**: Manage your applications and databases using the command line or through the API. - **Notifications**: Get notified when your deployments succeed or fail (via Slack, Discord, Telegram, Email, etc.). - **Multi Server**: Deploy and manage your applications remotely to external servers. - **Self-Hosted**: Self-host Dokploy on your VPS. ## 🚀 Getting Started To get started, run the following command on a VPS: Want to skip the installation process? [Try the Dokploy Cloud](https://app.dokploy.com). ```bash curl -sSL https://dokploy.com/install.sh | bash ``` For detailed documentation, visit [docs.dokploy.com](https://docs.dokploy.com). [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Siumauricio) ### Contributors 🤝 ## 📺 Video Tutorial ## 🤝 Contributing Check out the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information.
